buttermilk.ratio: 1 cup buttermilk = 1 cup milk + 1 tbsp white vinegar (rest 5 minutes)
buttermilk.notes: Best for pancakes and quick breads.

brown sugar.ratio: 1 cup brown sugar = 1 cup granulated sugar + 1 tbsp honey

baking powder.ratio: 1 tsp baking powder = 1/4 tsp baking soda + 1/2 tsp lemon juice

cake flour.ratio: 1 cup cake flour = 1 cup minus 2 tbsp all-purpose flour + 2 tbsp cornstarch
